subject: Clarify backup snapshot & KMS custody evidence needed for SOC 2 window
messages:
From: Diane Hoffman <diane.hoffman@clearwavemed.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodai.com>
Cc: jim@archvault.io
Date: Fri, 05 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 backup coverage window + evidence ask

Hi Marissa / Neha,

Thanks for walking through scope last week. A couple of follow-ups from our compliance team as they prepare for the vendor evidence pack: they want explicit coverage for backups/snapshots in your SOC 2 Type II and confirmation on who controls the KMS keys for backups. Specifically:

- Can Redwood confirm whether backup snapshots stored in the cloud are covered by your cloud provider's SOC 2 or by a carve-out/subservice assertion?
- If there is a bridge letter available, we need wording that covers the audit window 2026-10-01 through 2027-03-31.
- As evidence, they have asked for:
  * an inventory of snapshots taken in the audit window (at least filename, date/time, bucket, retention policy)
  * a statement on key custody for backups (Redwood-managed KMS vs customer-managed keys)
  * a current subprocessor list for backup-related vendors (e.g., ArchVault)

Can you confirm what you can provide and by when? Our internal deadline to hand off to the auditor is 2027-02-16. We also looped in Jim from ArchVault in case he needs to supply vendor statements.

Thanks,
Diane
Diane Hoffman
Security Lead, ClearWave Medical
---
Note: this email originally came from our procurement tracker: PO-9876

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>
To: Diane Hoffman <diane.hoffman@clearwavemed.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodai.com>, mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodai.com>, jim@archvault.io
Date: Fri, 05 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 backup coverage window + evidence ask

Hi Diane — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front:

- Redwood does not carve out routine snapshot storage from our SOC 2; we rely on our cloud providers' SOC 2 for the underlying infrastructure controls and Redwood's own SOC 2 covers our operational controls for snapshot management. That said, there are a few cases where we require vendor attestations (third-party backup appliance vendors).

- We can produce a snapshot inventory CSV for the requested audit window and a draft bridge letter that addresses the exact dates you listed (2026-10-01 to 2027-03-31).

- Key custody: for standard hosted accounts, Redwood manages envelope-wrapped keys stored in the cloud provider KMS; we do offer a customer-managed-key (CMK) option for Dedicated/Private deployments — if you are on a CMK plan, please tell us and we will provide a separate attestation.

Action plan and timelines:
- I will send a snapshot inventory extract and the draft bridge letter by EOD Tue 2027-02-09.
- Neha, can you confirm the subprocessor statement for ArchVault and attach any vendor attestation?
- Mina, please prepare a short key-custody declaration we can include (who holds the root key, rotation cadence, HSM usage).

If the auditor needs logs (snapshot create/delete events), call that out and we will add an export — but note that large event exports may take 48 hours.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Manager, Security & Compliance Solutions
Redwood Inference

On Fri, Feb 5, 2027 at 09:12 AM Diane Hoffman <diane.hoffman@clearwavemed.com> wrote:

Date: Mon, 08 Feb 2027 11:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 backup coverage window + evidence ask

Marissa / Mina — quick internal note and question for the thread before we hand off to Diane:

- I've confirmed with the cloud ops team that snapshot-create/delete events for the window exist in our audit log bucket (retained 18 months). We can export a filtered CSV including event_id, timestamp, object_id, actor, and retention_policy. Export might be ~12k rows for the window (we'll sample first).

- ArchVault (jim) has an attestation PDF that covers their appliance software but not the storage provider; Jim, can you confirm you are willing to sign a short statement that the backup app did not intercept keys and that backups are encrypted before they leave the instance? If so, send to me and I'll attach it to the evidence pack.

- Mina: for the key-custody declaration, I drafted a one-paragraph attest that we control the envelope keys in provider KMS for hosted accounts and that CMK customers have separate attestations. I attached the draft here as kms-ownership-declaration.txt. Can you review and add HSM wording (where applicable)?

Thanks,
Neha

Attachment: kms-ownership-declaration.txt (draft)

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>
To: Diane Hoffman <diane.hoffman@clearwavemed.com>, Jim Park <jim@archvault.io>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodai.com>, mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodai.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Feb 2027 16:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Final: snapshot inventory + draft bridge letter (evidence pack)

Diane — attaching the initial evidence pack for your auditor. Per our timeline, this should cover the items you asked for and the audit window 2026-10-01 through 2027-03-31.

Included attachments (stubs):
- Redwood_Snapshot_Inventory_20270209.csv — columns: snapshot_id, created_at, bucket, path, retention_days, created_by
- draft-bridge-letter-20270209.pdf — draft wording that references our SOC 2 Type II report and explicitly covers the window you requested; please review and mark any language changes required by your counsel.
- kms-ownership-declaration.txt — short attestation: Redwood-managed envelope keys in provider KMS for hosted customers; CMK customers get separate attestation. (Neha/Mina: finalized HSM sentence added.)

A few notes for the auditor:
- Snapshot storage relies on our cloud provider's physical/control environment SOC 2. Redwood's SOC 2 covers logical controls around snapshot lifecycle, access, and retention. We have not carved out snapshot storage except where a third-party backup appliance is used; in those cases we include vendor attestations.
- If the auditor requires raw snapshot-create/delete event logs, tell us which fields they need and we will export a CSV (export lead time up to 48 hours).

Next steps: please confirm by 2027-02-11 if the draft bridge letter wording is acceptable or whether counsel needs edits. Jim — can you confirm vendor attestation availability by 2027-02-11 as well?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Manager, Security & Compliance Solutions
Redwood Inference
